impact_scope.description: Introduces the public LZIP decoder and its base.io_transformer entry point, including caller-provided source, destination, and work buffer.

evidence: S0 has no matching declaration in the selected production source file, so the newly anchored LZIP decoder entry point had no S0 harness exposure obligation.
S1 introduces public struct decoder implementing base.io_transformer and public decoder.transform_io(dst, src, workbuf).
H0 enables and invokes only AUX/BASE/JSON modules and JSON decoding paths; it neither enables the LZIP module nor constructs or calls the LZIP decoder.

new_harness_obligation.description: H0 would need to enable the new LZIP module and add a LZIP decoder invocation with caller-supplied source, destination, and work buffer to expose this entry point.
evidence: The LZIP public declaration and transform_io callable are absent in S0 and introduced in S1.
The existing harness configuration contains no LZIP module definition, and its fuzz entry routes inputs exclusively through JSON decoders.

reason: The principal scope is the newly introduced public LZIP decoder transform entry point, not an older sibling codec or a project-wide codec omission. Its declaration is absent in S0, making Gap(S0,H0) false under the identity rule. It exists in S1 but remains unreachable from the unchanged JSON-only H0, making Gap(S1,H0) true. This creates concrete compile-time configuration and call/buffer obligations for H0, so the delta is NEW and maintenance is needed.
